description: A sprite sheet of NINE separate small props arranged in a 3 by 3 grid, each small and centered in its own cell: broken chunk of stone dam wall, old stone culvert pillar, rusty iron sluice gate wheel, small stone memorial for the drowned, sunken thatched roof peeking out of water, half sunken wooden boat, rusty drainage pipe end, coil of rusty iron chain, collapsed stone bridge pier, drawn in straight FRONT VIEW like the reference (facing the camera, slight top-down), thick dark outline, soft cel shading, every object fully separate on a plain flat solid bright magenta (#FF00FF) chroma-key background with wide empty space around it, no ground, no shadow puddles, no text, no characters
style_usage: Copy ONLY the art style of this reference: chunky chibi pixel art, thick dark outline on every shape, soft cel shading, front-facing view. Do not copy these objects or their colors.
